title: Combine the Skills
prompt: Write count_special(words) counting words that start with a vowel (a, e, i, o, u — case-insensitive) AND are at least 3 characters long.

tests.name: combined predicate
tests.code:
ws = ["Apple", "ant", "egg", "elephant", "bee", "Owl", "ig"]
assert count_special(ws) == 5, f"Apple/ant/egg/elephant/Owl qualify, got {count_special(ws)}"
assert count_special(["bee", "ig"]) == 0, "bee is not a vowel word; ig is too short"
assert count_special([]) == 0
tests.hint: w[0].lower() in 'aeiou' and len(w) >= 3 — both conditions, one counter.
